sources.quote: HD 206610, also known as Bosona, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet in the constellation of Aquarius.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.7 solar radii and 1.14 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,799 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
